name: Shopify
shortInfo: Shopify is complete e-commerce platform that lets you start, grow, and manage a business.
brief: Shopify is a user-friendly e-commerce platform that helps small businesses build an online store and sell online through one streamlined dashboard.
about: The Shopify Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Shopify platform in an automated manner.
availableSync:
[Customers](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/shopify/syncs/customers.html)

This sync can be used to upload customers' details from your data warehouse to the Shopify platform.

[Inventory Items](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/shopify/syncs/inventory-items.html)

This sync can be used to upload inventory items' details from your data warehouse to the Shopify platform.

[Orders](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/shopify/syncs/orders.html)

This sync can be used to upload orders' details from your data warehouse to the Shopify platform.

[Products](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/shopify/syncs/products.html)

This sync can be used to upload products' details from your data warehouse to the Shopify platform.
